tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia (with low hemoglobin and MCH), thrombocytopenia, and increased red cell distribution width, suggesting possible chronic disease or bone marrow dysfunction. There is also hypercholesterolemia (notably high LDL), elevated HbA1c indicating suboptimal glycemic control, mild hyperkalemia, and low total protein. Renal and liver function are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying hematologic or metabolic disorders are recommended.
